services.name: luxury yacht rental
services.desc: Enjoy Lake Michigan in luxury and style with Highland Park’s premier private yacht charter company, Anita Dee Yacht Charters. We have been in the charter business for nearly 40 years. Come aboard one of our luxurious yachts for a truly unique experience with family, friends, colleagues, and clients. Our team of experienced event planners and hospitality specialists can deliver a one-of-a-kind event for any occasion - weddings, birthday parties, networking events, and much more. If you have a vision, we can make it a reality, customizing every detail from the catering and entertainment to the cruise route and décor. For over three decades, Anita Dee Yacht Charters has been delighting our

includes: On-site event coordinator before and during event
Top-of-the-line entertainment system with sound and AV technology
Access to preferred caterers and licensed, insured outside caterers
Photography and videography services from preferred vendors
gap: Age and weight requirements not stated
blurb: Guests charter private luxury yachts for corporate events such as award ceremonies, anniversaries, conventions, tradeshows, breakfast meetings, and networking events. The yachts cruise on Lake Michigan or the Chicago River with customizable routes and docking locations. Services include catering, music, décor, photography, and event coordination.
extraNote: Booking times and routes are customizable · No multiple events booked on the same cruise; exclusive use of yacht · On-site coordinator manages event and clean-up · Yachts docked on the Chicago River at Lake Shore Drive; other docking locations available in Illinois, Indiana, and Wisconsin
